title: Revelation Space
author: Reynolds, Alastair
review:
This was awesome. Felt satisfied with the ending and there's a lot more of the series left which I'm excited to read. Really great balance of mind blowing ideas, cool plot, and interesting world building. Reynolds is probably my favorite space opera author and this might be my favorite book of his I've read so far.

Sort of feel similarly towards this as I do Three Body Problem where I don't think it's for everyone and some people will bounce off of it hard but for me personally it's right up my alley. It's also very technical at times and you can tell it was written by an astrophysicist, but I loved this aspect and feels very grounded in real science but expanded in a huge way to explore big ideas.

The characters and exposition dumps are probably the weak parts but some of this can sort of be handwaved away by the amount of post humanism the characters have undergone.

Pretty hooked by this and eager to read Chasm City SOOOON
